description: This file defines the Address model class for handling customer address data in an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving address records from the database, along with associated metadata like country, zone, and address formats.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Model class for managing customer addresses, including CRUD operations and fetching address details.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Creates a new address entry in the database for a specific customer.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Updates an existing address record for a customer.

methods.name: deleteAddresses
methods.description: Deletes address records for a customer, optionally a specific address.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific address, including country, zone, and format details.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves all addresses for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalAddresses
methods.description: Returns the total count of addresses associated with a customer.
